description: ForestGuard Agent is a Web3-enabled autonomous multi-agent AI system for real-time detection, verification, and reporting of deforestation. It ingests satellite, drone, and community-submitted images, detects tree loss, verifies flagged events, estimates carbon impact, and generates tamper-proof incident packages. Reports are tokenized on the Somnia network (NFTs), enabling verifiable environmental impact tracking. The app combines AI + Web3 to incentivize real users, create hype, and support eco-credits or tokenized rewards.
goal: Build a fully functional, semi-vibe-coded or vibe-coded ForestGuard Agent app with frontend, backend, agent workflows, ML inference, notifications, reporting, decentralized storage, Web3 token/NFT integration, and adoption-ready UX flows for 40+ real users. The app should have viral/utility hooks, be hackathon-ready, and comply with Web3 bounty preferences.

endpoints.description: Accepts images/metadata, triggers Somnia/Web3 agentic pipeline, returns incident ID, pipeline status, transaction hash, reward points
Returns incidents list with Web3 token verification and reward eligibility
Returns detailed incident data including NFT proof, agent transcripts, and reward status
Trigger agentic workflow for images; logs reasoning and NFT minting steps
Send alerts to Slack, Telegram, Email, or Web3 dashboard

agentic_pipeline_logic.step1: Vision Agent detects deforestation; outputs polygons & confidence
agentic_pipeline_logic.step2: Verifier Agent cross-checks polygons with historical data
agentic_pipeline_logic.step3: Geolocation Agent calculates area & carbon impact
agentic_pipeline_logic.step4: Packager Agent generates PDF report & agent transcript
agentic_pipeline_logic.step5: Decentralization/NFT Agent publishes incident to Somnia, mints NFT/reward tokens
agentic_pipeline_logic.step6: Notification Agent sends alerts to users/Slack/Telegram/Email
agentic_pipeline_logic.error_handling: Pipeline stops on failure; logs error, notifies user; partial Somnia/NFT commits rolled back
